name: Archer
fantasy: The warden of high ground. Climbs, reads the field, pins people to walls.
silhouette: the long weapon over the shoulder

card.loop: Snares root and feed Focus; full Focus makes your next shot into a rooted foe a Deadeye.
card.dash: Fire a grapple line: zip up to a ledge (Focus builds faster up high), or hop back.
card.passive: Focus fills standing still and when a snare roots; full = Deadeye ready (+18, crit).
card.rmb: Tap: a rooting snare. Hold: a charged Heavy Shot that pierces, knocks back and stuns into a wall.
card.e: Arrow Rain: a wall of falling arrows across their path (damage, slow, healing blighted).
card.r: Great Arrows: your next 3 shots need no draw, fly far, pierce and knock back; the third hits hardest.

weapons.longbow: Hold to draw in stages: 30, then 60 at full; let go right at full draw (PERFECT) for +25%.
weapons.sniper: A visible aim laser, then one heavy round.

passive.name: Focus
passive.desc: Builds while you stand still (full in 1.4s), sneak (2.8s), 50% faster on high ground; a snare or Pinning Shot that hits adds 40 (a Pin into a wall fills it). Drains while running and drops 40 when hit. At 100 your next shot is fully drawn or aimed at once, with +20% range, and if it hits a rooted or stunned foe it is a Deadeye: +18 damage, a crit.

dash.name: Grapple Arrow
dash.desc: A line arrow at the cursor (9m). If it bites a wall, rock or ledge you zip to it and climb on top; if it bites nothing you hop 3.2m back. Works from a glide and cools it.

variants.tap: A snare arrow 11m: 8 damage and root 0.6 on a foe; on the ground it plants a Tripwire (root 1.2, reveal 3s).
variants.hold: Heavy Shot: charge 0.5s -> full at 1.1s (rising creak, a ring, a ping at full): 16 -> 30 damage, push 6 -> 12, pierces 2; driven into a wall within 3m it stuns 0.8 (PINNED).
variants.air: Plunge: shoot straight down, push 8 around you, lift yourself 3m, cool the glider.
variants.during_e: With your Arrow Rain falling the tap snare roots 1.0.

e.name: Arrow Rain
e.desc: Lob a volley up to 9m: 0.35s later a wall of arrows rains along a 6m line across your aim for 3.75s. Foes inside take 5 every 0.5s, are slowed 35% and blighted (healing barely takes).

r.name: Great Arrows
r.desc: A 0.5s fuse, then for 6s your next 3 shots need no draw: great arrows that fly 22m, pierce everyone, knock back and hit for 28, 28 and 44 (the third a payoff hit that stuns 1.0 into a wall).

rank2.ult: Rank 2 (level 9): cooldown 100s -> 85s, +30% duration, +15% damage; the window lasts 7.8s.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 9s -> 7.2s, damage +30%; max 3 live Tripwires.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 15s -> 12s, damage +30%; the Arrow Rain is 1m longer.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 7s -> 4.9s; the backward hop refunds 40%.

tells.full: a bright glint and a thin aim line; crosshairs over every rooted foe
tells.dash_spent: the rope line, dash pip dark
